summary: Google DeepMind released a patch version of the Sonnet TensorFlow library fixing use of an internal TF symbol removed in a recent TensorFlow release.

practices.reason: A compatibility fix for an internal TensorFlow symbol change means teams using Sonnet must update to this patch version to avoid breakage.
practices.quote: Fixes use of internal TF symbol removed in a minor release <= 2.10.0. (Fixes #273)
